@dataclass
class UnaryExpr(Expr):
    op: str
    expr: Expr

    def eval(self, ctx: "EvalContext") -> Any:
        value = self.expr.eval(ctx)
        if self.op == "not":
            return not truthy(value)
        if self.op == "+":
            number = to_number(value)
            return number if number is not None else None
        if self.op == "-":
            number = to_number(value)
            return -number if number is not None else None
        return None

    def contains_aggregate(self) -> bool:
        return self.expr.contains_aggregate()

    def label(self) -> str:
        if self.op == "not":
            return f"Not {self.expr.label()}"
        return f"{self.op}{self.expr.label()}"

    def sql_display(self) -> str:
        if self.op == "not":
            return f"not {self.expr.sql_display()}"
        return f"{self.op}{self.expr.sql_display()}"


@dataclass
class BinaryExpr(Expr):
    op: str
    left: Expr
    right: Expr

    def eval(self, ctx: "EvalContext") -> Any:
        if self.op in ("and", "or"):
            left_value = truthy(self.left.eval(ctx))
            if self.op == "and":
                return left_value and truthy(self.right.eval(ctx))
            return left_value or truthy(self.right.eval(ctx))

        left_value = self.left.eval(ctx)
        right_value = self.right.eval(ctx)
        return eval_binary_math(self.op, left_value, right_value)

    def contains_aggregate(self) -> bool:
        return self.left.contains_aggregate() or self.right.contains_aggregate()

    def label(self) -> str:
        if self.op in ("+", "-", "*", "/", "%"):
            op_words = {"+": "Add", "-": "Subtract", "*": "Multiply", "/": "Divide", "%": "Modulo"}
            return f"{self.left.label()} {op_words[self.op]} {self.right.label()}"
        if self.op == "and":
            return f"{self.left.label()} And {self.right.label()}"
        if self.op == "or":
            return f"{self.left.label()} Or {self.right.label()}"
        return f"{self.left.label()} {self.op} {self.right.label()}"

    def sql_display(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.left.sql_display()} {self.op} {self.right.sql_display()}"


@dataclass
class CompareExpr(Expr):
    op: str
    left: Expr
    right: Expr

    def eval(self, ctx: "EvalContext") -> Any:
        return compare_values(self.op, self.left.eval(ctx), self.right.eval(ctx), ctx.options)

    def contains_aggregate(self) -> bool:
        return self.left.contains_aggregate() or self.right.contains_aggregate()

    def label(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.left.label()} {self.op} {self.right.label()}"

    def sql_display(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.left.sql_display()} {self.op} {self.right.sql_display()}"


@dataclass
class BetweenExpr(Expr):
    expr: Expr
    low: Expr
    high: Expr
    negate: bool = False

    def eval(self, ctx: "EvalContext") -> Any:
        value = self.expr.eval(ctx)
        low = self.low.eval(ctx)
        high = self.high.eval(ctx)
        result = in_between(value, low, high, ctx.options)
        return not result if self.negate else result

    def contains_aggregate(self) -> bool:
        return self.expr.contains_aggregate() or self.low.contains_aggregate() or self.high.contains_aggregate()

    def label(self) -> str:
        phrase = "NotBetween" if self.negate else "Between"
        return f"{self.expr.label()} {phrase} {self.low.label()} And {self.high.label()}"

    def sql_display(self) -> str:
        text = "not between" if self.negate else "between"
        return f"{self.expr.sql_display()} {text} {self.low.sql_display()} and {self.high.sql_display()}"


@dataclass
class InExpr(Expr):
    expr: Expr
    items: list[Expr]
    negate: bool = False

    def eval(self, ctx: "EvalContext") -> Any:
        left = self.expr.eval(ctx)
        found = any(compare_values("=", left, item.eval(ctx), ctx.options) for item in self.items)
        return not found if self.negate else found

    def contains_aggregate(self) -> bool:
        return self.expr.contains_aggregate() or any(item.contains_aggregate() for item in self.items)

    def label(self) -> str:
        prefix = "NotIn" if self.negate else "In"
        return f"{self.expr.label()} {prefix}"

    def sql_display(self) -> str:
        operator = "not in" if self.negate else "in"
        items = ", ".join(item.sql_display() for item in self.items)
        return f"{self.expr.sql_display()} {operator} ({items})"


@dataclass
class FunctionExpr(Expr):
    name: str
    args: list[Expr]

    def eval(self, ctx: "EvalContext") -> Any:
        return eval_function(self.name, self.args, ctx)

    def contains_aggregate(self) -> bool:
        if self.name in AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS:
            return True
        return any(arg.contains_aggregate() for arg in self.args)

    def label(self) -> str:
        if self.name in AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS:
            args = ",".join(arg.sql_display() for arg in self.args)
            return f"{self.name}({args})"
        return f"{camel(self.name)}({', '.join(arg.label() for arg in self.args)})"

    def sql_display(self) -> str:
        args = ",".join(arg.sql_display() for arg in self.args)
        return f"{self.name}({args})"


@dataclass
class EvalContext:
    options: GlobalOptions
    row: Optional["FileRow"] = None
    group: Optional[list["FileRow"]] = None

    @property
    def base_row(self) -> Optional["FileRow"]:
        if self.row is not None:
            return self.row
        if self.group:
            return self.group[0]
        return None


def parse_query(raw_query: str, cwd: str) -> Query:
    stream = TokenStream(tokenize(raw_query))
    if stream.match("select"):
        stream.advance()
    select_exprs = parse_expr_list(stream, stop_words=CLAUSE_WORDS)
    if not select_exprs:
        raise QueryError("query: Error parsing expression, expecting string")

    roots = [RootSpec(raw_path=cwd, path=cwd)]
    where_expr: Optional[Expr] = None
    group_by: list[Expr] = []
    order_by: list[OrderItem] = []
    limit: Optional[int] = None
    offset = 0
    output_format = "tabs"

    if stream.match("from"):
        stream.advance()
        roots = parse_roots(stream, cwd)

    if stream.match("where"):
        stream.advance()
        where_expr = parse_expr(stream)

    if stream.match("group"):
        stream.advance()
        stream.expect("by")
        group_by = parse_expr_list(stream, stop_words={"order", "limit", "offset", "into"})

    if stream.match("order"):
        stream.advance()
        stream.expect("by")
        order_by = parse_order_list(stream)

    if stream.match("limit"):
        stream.advance()
        limit_token = stream.advance()
        limit = parse_int_literal(limit_token)

    if stream.match("offset"):
        stream.advance()
        offset_token = stream.advance()
        offset = parse_int_literal(offset_token)

    if stream.match("into"):
        stream.advance()
        format_token = stream.advance()
        output_format = format_token.lower

    if not stream.at_end():
        raise QueryError("query: could not parse tokens at the end of the query")

    return Query(
        raw=raw_query,
        select=select_exprs,
        roots=roots,
        where=where_expr,
        group_by=group_by,
        order_by=order_by,
        limit=limit,
        offset=offset,
        output_format=output_format,
    )


def parse_roots(stream: TokenStream, cwd: str) -> list[RootSpec]:
    roots: list[RootSpec] = []
    while True:
        token = stream.advance()
        if token.kind not in {"WORD", "STRING"}:
            raise QueryError("query: Error parsing expression, expecting string")
        path_value = token.text
        if not os.path.isabs(path_value):
            path_value = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(cwd, path_value))
        spec = RootSpec(raw_path=token.text, path=path_value)
        while True:
            if stream.match(",") or stream.match_kind("EOF"):
                break
            if stream.peek().kind == "WORD" and stream.peek().lower in CLAUSE_WORDS:
                break
            option = stream.peek().lower
            if option in ("mindepth",):
                stream.advance()
                spec.mindepth = parse_int_literal(stream.advance())
            elif option in ("maxdepth", "depth"):
                stream.advance()
                depth = parse_int_literal(stream.advance())
                spec.maxdepth = depth if depth > 0 else None
            elif option in ("symlinks", "sym"):
                stream.advance()
                spec.follow_symlinks = True
            elif option in ("archives", "arc"):
                stream.advance()
                spec.archives = True
            elif option == "dfs":
                stream.advance()
                spec.traversal = "dfs"
            elif option == "bfs":
                stream.advance()
                spec.traversal = "bfs"
            elif option in ("regexp", "rx"):
                stream.advance()
                spec.regexp = True
            elif option == "as":
                stream.advance()
                spec.alias = stream.advance().text
            elif option in ROOT_OPTION_WORDS:
                stream.advance()
            else:
                break
        roots.append(spec)
        if stream.match(","):
            stream.advance()
            continue
        break
    return roots


def parse_order_list(stream: TokenStream) -> list[OrderItem]:
    items: list[OrderItem] = []
    while not stream.at_end() and not (stream.peek().kind == "WORD" and stream.peek().lower in {"limit", "offset", "into"}):
        start_token = stream.peek()
        expr = parse_expr(stream)
        position = None
        if isinstance(expr, LiteralExpr) and isinstance(expr.value, int) and start_token.kind == "WORD":
            position = expr.value
        direction = "asc"
        if stream.match("asc", "desc"):
            direction = stream.advance().lower
        items.append(OrderItem(expr=expr, direction=direction, position=position))
        if stream.match(","):
            stream.advance()
            continue
        if stream.at_end() or (stream.peek().kind == "WORD" and stream.peek().lower in {"limit", "offset", "into"}):
            break
    return items


def parse_expr_list(stream: TokenStream, stop_words: set[str]) -> list[Expr]:
    items: list[Expr] = []
    while not stream.at_end():
        if stream.peek().kind == "WORD" and stream.peek().lower in stop_words:
            break
        items.append(parse_expr(stream))
        if stream.match(","):
            stream.advance()
            continue
        if stream.at_end():
            break
        if stream.peek().kind == "WORD" and stream.peek().lower in stop_words:
            break
    return items


def parse_expr(stream: TokenStream) -> Expr:
    return parse_or(stream)


def parse_or(stream: TokenStream) -> Expr:
    expr = parse_and(stream)
    while stream.match("or"):
        stream.advance()
        expr = BinaryExpr("or", expr, parse_and(stream))
    return expr


def parse_and(stream: TokenStream) -> Expr:
    expr = parse_not(stream)
    while stream.match("and"):
        stream.advance()
        expr = BinaryExpr("and", expr, parse_not(stream))
    return expr


def parse_not(stream: TokenStream) -> Expr:
    if stream.match("not"):
        if stream.peek(1).lower in {"in", "between", "like", "exists"}:
            return parse_comparison(stream)
        stream.advance()
        return UnaryExpr("not", parse_not(stream))
    return parse_comparison(stream)


def parse_comparison(stream: TokenStream) -> Expr:
    expr = parse_additive(stream)
    while True:
        token = stream.peek()
        lower = token.lower
        if lower in {"=", "==", "eq", "===", "eeq", "!=", "<>", "ne", "!==", "ene", "<", "lt", "<=", "lte", "le", ">", "gt", ">=", "gte", "ge", "=~", "~=", "regexp", "rx", "!=~", "!~=", "notrx", "like", "notlike"}:
            stream.advance()
            right = parse_additive(stream)
            expr = CompareExpr(lower, expr, right)
            continue
        if lower == "between":
            stream.advance()
            low = parse_additive(stream)
            stream.expect("and")
            high = parse_additive(stream)
            expr = BetweenExpr(expr, low, high)
            continue
        if lower == "not" and stream.peek(1).lower == "between":
            stream.advance()
            stream.advance()
            low = parse_additive(stream)
            stream.expect("and")
            high = parse_additive(stream)
            expr = BetweenExpr(expr, low, high, negate=True)
            continue
        if lower == "in":
            stream.advance()
            expr = InExpr(expr, parse_in_items(stream))
            continue
        if lower == "not" and stream.peek(1).lower == "in":
            stream.advance()
            stream.advance()
            expr = InExpr(expr, parse_in_items(stream), negate=True)
            continue
        break
    return expr


def parse_in_items(stream: TokenStream) -> list[Expr]:
    open_tok = stream.advance()
    if open_tok.text not in {"(", "{"}:
        raise QueryError("query: Error parsing expression, expecting string")
    if stream.match("select"):
        raise QueryError("query: could not parse tokens at the end of the query")
    closing = ")" if open_tok.text == "(" else "}"
    items: list[Expr] = []
    while not stream.match(closing):
        items.append(parse_expr(stream))
        if stream.match(","):
            stream.advance()
            continue
        if stream.match(closing):
            break
    stream.expect(closing)
    return items


def parse_additive(stream: TokenStream) -> Expr:
    expr = parse_multiplicative(stream)
    while stream.match("+", "-"):
        op = stream.advance().text
        expr = BinaryExpr(op, expr, parse_multiplicative(stream))
    return expr


def parse_multiplicative(stream: TokenStream) -> Expr:
    expr = parse_unary(stream)
    while stream.match("*", "/", "%"):
        op = stream.advance().text
        expr = BinaryExpr(op, expr, parse_unary(stream))
    return expr


def parse_unary(stream: TokenStream) -> Expr:
    if stream.match("+", "-"):
        op = stream.advance().text
        return UnaryExpr(op, parse_unary(stream))
    return parse_primary(stream)


def parse_primary(stream: TokenStream) -> Expr:
    token = stream.advance()
    if token.text in {"(", "{"}:
        closing = ")" if token.text == "(" else "}"
        expr = parse_expr(stream)
        stream.expect(closing)
        return expr
    if token.kind == "STRING":
        return LiteralExpr(token.text)
    if token.text == "*":
        return StarExpr()
    if token.kind == "WORD":
        if re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?\d+", token.text):
            return LiteralExpr(int(token.text))
        if re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?\d+\.\d+", token.text):
            return LiteralExpr(float(token.text))
        if token.lower in BOOL_WORDS:
            return LiteralExpr(BOOL_WORDS[token.lower])
        if stream.peek().text in {"(", "{"}:
            func_name = FUNCTION_ALIASES.get(token.lower, token.lower)
            open_tok = stream.advance()
            closing = ")" if open_tok.text == "(" else "}"
            args: list[Expr] = []
            while not stream.match(closing):
                args.append(parse_expr(stream))
                if stream.match(","):
                    stream.advance()
                    continue
                if stream.match(closing):
                    break
            stream.expect(closing)
            return FunctionExpr(func_name, args)
        if token.lower in FUNCTION_ALIASES and FUNCTION_ALIASES[token.lower] in NOARG_FUNCTIONS:
            return FunctionExpr(FUNCTION_ALIASES[token.lower], [])
        spec = FIELD_ALIASES.get(token.lower)
        if spec is not None:
            return ColumnExpr(spec)
        return LiteralExpr(token.text)
    raise QueryError("query: Error parsing expression, expecting string")


def parse_int_literal(token: Token) -> int:
    try:
        return int(token.text)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise QueryError("query: Error parsing expression, expecting string") from exc


def eval_binary_math(op: str, left: Any, right: Any) -> Any:
    left_num = to_number(left)
    right_num = to_number(right)
    if left_num is None or right_num is None:
        return None
    if op == "+":
        return left_num + right_num
    if op == "-":
        return left_num - right_num
    if op == "*":
        return left_num * right_num
    if op == "/":
        if right_num == 0:
            return None
        result = left_num / right_num
        if isinstance(left_num, int) and isinstance(right_num, int):
            return int(result)
        return result
    if op == "%":
        if right_num == 0:
            return None
        return left_num % right_num
    return None


def truthy(value: Any) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return value
    if value is None:
        return False
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return value != 0
    if isinstance(value, str):
        lowered = value.strip().lower()
        if lowered in {"", "false", "0", "off", "no"}:
            return False
        if lowered in {"true", "1", "on", "yes"}:
            return True
    return bool(value)


def to_number(value: Any) -> Optional[int | float]:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return int(value)
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, str):
        if re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?\d+", value):
            return int(value)
        if re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?\d+\.\d+", value):
            return float(value)
    return None


def to_datetime(value: Any, options: GlobalOptions) -> Optional[dt.datetime]:
    if isinstance(value, dt.datetime):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, dt.date):
        return dt.datetime.combine(value, dt.time())
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(value)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        parsed = parse_date_interval(value, options)
        if parsed is not None:
            return parsed[0]
        try:
            return dt.datetime.fromisoformat(value)
        except Exception:
            return None
    return None


def compare_values(op: str, left: Any, right: Any, options: GlobalOptions) -> bool:
    left_dt = to_datetime(left, options)
    right_interval = parse_date_interval(right, options) if isinstance(right, str) else None
    if left_dt is not None and right_interval is not None:
        start, end = right_interval
        if op in {"=", "==", "eq"}:
            return start <= left_dt <= end
        if op in {"!=", "<>", "ne"}:
            return not (start <= left_dt <= end)
        right_dt = start
        return compare_ordered(op, left_dt, right_dt)

    if isinstance(left, bool) or isinstance(right, bool):
        return compare_ordered(op, truthy(left), truthy(right))
    left_num = to_number(left)
    right_num = to_number(right)
    if left_num is not None and right_num is not None:
        return compare_ordered(op, left_num, right_num)
    left_text = "" if left is None else format_scalar(left)
    right_text = "" if right is None else format_scalar(right)

    if op in {"=", "==", "eq"}:
        if has_glob(right_text):
            return fnmatch.fnmatchcase(left_text, right_text)
        return left_text == right_text
    if op in {"===", "eeq"}:
        return left_text == right_text
    if op in {"!=", "<>", "ne"}:
        if has_glob(right_text):
            return not fnmatch.fnmatchcase(left_text, right_text)
        return left_text != right_text
    if op in {"!==", "ene"}:
        return left_text != right_text
    if op in {"=~", "~=", "regexp", "rx"}:
        return regex_match(right_text, left_text)
    if op in {"!=~", "!~=", "notrx"}:
        return not regex_match(right_text, left_text)
    if op == "like":
        return like_match(left_text, right_text)
    if op == "notlike":
        return not like_match(left_text, right_text)
    return compare_ordered(op, left_text, right_text)


def compare_ordered(op: str, left: Any, right: Any) -> bool:
    if op in {"=", "==", "eq", "===", "eeq"}:
        return left == right
    if op in {"!=", "<>", "ne", "!==", "ene"}:
        return left != right
    if op in {"<", "lt"}:
        return left < right
    if op in {"<=", "lte", "le"}:
        return left <= right
    if op in {">", "gt"}:
        return left > right
    if op in {">=", "gte", "ge"}:
        return left >= right
    return False


def in_between(value: Any, low: Any, high: Any, options: GlobalOptions) -> bool:
    value_dt = to_datetime(value, options)
    low_dt = to_datetime(low, options)
    high_dt = to_datetime(high, options)
    if value_dt is not None and low_dt is not None and high_dt is not None:
        return low_dt <= value_dt <= high_dt
    value_num = to_number(value)
    low_num = to_number(low)
    high_num = to_number(high)
    if value_num is not None and low_num is not None and high_num is not None:
        return low_num <= value_num <= high_num
    value_text = format_scalar(value)
    low_text = format_scalar(low)
    high_text = format_scalar(high)
    return low_text <= value_text <= high_text


def has_glob(text: str) -> bool:
    return "*" in text or "?" in text or "[" in text


def regex_match(pattern: str, text: str) -> bool:
    try:
        return re.search(pattern, text) is not None
    except re.error:
        return False


def like_match(text: str, pattern: str) -> bool:
    regex = []
    for char in pattern:
        if char == "%":
            regex.append(".*")
        elif char == "_":
            regex.append(".")
        else:
            regex.append(re.escape(char))
    return re.fullmatch("".join(regex), text) is not None


def parse_date_interval(value: Any, options: GlobalOptions) -> Optional[tuple[dt.datetime, dt.datetime]]:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return None
    text = value.strip()
    lowered = text.lower()
    today = dt.datetime.now().date()
    if lowered == "today":
        start = dt.datetime.combine(today, dt.time())
        end = start + dt.timedelta(days=1) - dt.timedelta(seconds=1)
        return start, end
    if lowered == "yesterday":
        day = today - dt.timedelta(days=1)
        start = dt.datetime.combine(day, dt.time())
        end = start + dt.timedelta(days=1) - dt.timedelta(seconds=1)
        return start, end
    if re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?\d+", text):
        day = today + dt.timedelta(days=int(text))
        start = dt.datetime.combine(day, dt.time())
        end = start + dt.timedelta(days=1) - dt.timedelta(seconds=1)
        return start, end
    patterns = [
        (r"(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$", "day"),
        (r"(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{2})$", "hour"),
        (r"(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{2}):(\d{2})$", "minute"),
        (r"(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2}) (\d{2}):(\d{2}):(\d{2})$", "second"),
    ]
    for pattern, precision in patterns:
        match = re.fullmatch(pattern, text)
        if match:
            parts = [int(part) for part in match.groups()]
            year, month, day = parts[:3]
            hour = parts[3] if len(parts) > 3 else 0
            minute = parts[4] if len(parts) > 4 else 0
            second = parts[5] if len(parts) > 5 else 0
            start = dt.datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, second)
            if precision == "day":
                end = start + dt.timedelta(days=1) - dt.timedelta(seconds=1)
            elif precision == "hour":
                end = start + dt.timedelta(hours=1) - dt.timedelta(seconds=1)
            elif precision == "minute":
                end = start + dt.timedelta(minutes=1) - dt.timedelta(seconds=1)
            else:
                end = start
            return start, end
    match = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{1,2})/(\d{1,2})$", text)
    if match:
        first, second = (int(part) for part in match.groups())
        month = first if options.us_dates else second
        day = second if options.us_dates else first
        start = dt.datetime(today.year, month, day)
        end = start + dt.timedelta(days=1) - dt.timedelta(seconds=1)
        return start, end
    return None


def format_scalar(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    if isinstance(value, dt.datetime):
        return value.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    if isinstance(value, dt.date):
        return value.isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, float):
        if math.isfinite(value) and value.is_integer():
            return str(int(value))
        return str(value)
    return str(value)


def format_size(num: Any) -> str:
    value = to_number(num)
    if value is None:
        return ""
    size = float(value)
    units = ["B", "KiB", "MiB", "GiB", "TiB", "PiB"]
    idx = 0
    while size >= 1024 and idx < len(units) - 1:
        size /= 1024
        idx += 1
    if idx == 0:
        return f"{int(size)}B"
    if size.is_integer():
        return f"{int(size)}{units[idx]}"
    return f"{size:.2f}{units[idx]}"


def format_duration(value: Any) -> str:
    number = to_number(value)
    if number is None:
        return ""
    seconds = int(number)
    if seconds == 0:
        return "0μs"
    parts: list[str] = []
    units = [
        ("d", 24 * 60 * 60),
        ("h", 60 * 60),
        ("m", 60),
        ("s", 1),
    ]
    remaining = seconds
    for label, unit_seconds in units:
        if remaining >= unit_seconds:
            amount, remaining = divmod(remaining, unit_seconds)
            parts.append(f"{amount}{label}")
    return ",".join(parts)


def sort_key(value: Any) -> tuple[int, Any]:
    if value is None:
        return (1, "")
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return (0, int(value))
    if isinstance(value, dt.datetime):
        return (0, value.timestamp())
    if isinstance(value, dt.date):
        return (0, value.isoformat())
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return (0, value)
    return (0, str(value))


def eval_function(name: str, args: list[Expr], ctx: EvalContext) -> Any:
    if name in AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS:
        rows = ctx.group or []
        return eval_aggregate(name, args, rows, ctx.options)
    values = [arg.eval(ctx) for arg in args]
    row = ctx.base_row

    if name == "lower":
        return format_scalar(values[0]).lower() if values else ""
    if name == "upper":
        return format_scalar(values[0]).upper() if values else ""
    if name == "initcap":
        return format_scalar(values[0]).title() if values else ""
    if name == "length":
        return len(format_scalar(values[0])) if values else 0
    if name == "to_base64":
        return base64.b64encode(format_scalar(values[0]).encode()).decode() if values else ""
    if name == "from_base64":
        if not values:
            return ""
        try:
            return base64.b64decode(format_scalar(values[0])).decode(errors="replace")
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "concat":
        return "".join(format_scalar(value) for value in values)
    if name == "concat_ws":
        if not values:
            return ""
        sep = format_scalar(values[0])
        return sep.join(format_scalar(value) for value in values[1:])
    if name == "locate":
        if len(values) < 2:
            return 0
        value = format_scalar(values[0])
        needle = format_scalar(values[1])
        idx = value.find(needle)
        return idx + 1 if idx >= 0 else 0
    if name == "substr":
        if not values:
            return ""
        text = format_scalar(values[0])
        start = int(to_number(values[1]) or 1)
        if len(values) >= 3:
            length = int(to_number(values[2]) or 0)
            return text[max(start - 1, 0):max(start - 1, 0) + length]
        return text[max(start - 1, 0):]
    if name == "replace":
        if len(values) < 3:
            return ""
        return format_scalar(values[0]).replace(format_scalar(values[1]), format_scalar(values[2]))
    if name == "trim":
        return format_scalar(values[0]).strip() if values else ""
    if name == "ltrim":
        return format_scalar(values[0]).lstrip() if values else ""
    if name == "rtrim":
        return format_scalar(values[0]).rstrip() if values else ""
    if name == "contains_japanese":
        return any(
            contains_range(format_scalar(values[0]), low, high)
            for low, high in ((0x3040, 0x309F), (0x30A0, 0x30FF), (0x4E00, 0x9FFF))
        ) if values else False
    if name == "contains_hiragana":
        return contains_range(format_scalar(values[0]), 0x3040, 0x309F) if values else False
    if name == "contains_katakana":
        return contains_range(format_scalar(values[0]), 0x30A0, 0x30FF) if values else False
    if name == "contains_kana":
        return any(contains_range(format_scalar(values[0]), low, high) for low, high in ((0x3040, 0x309F), (0x30A0, 0x30FF))) if values else False
    if name == "contains_kanji":
        return contains_range(format_scalar(values[0]), 0x4E00, 0x9FFF) if values else False
    if name == "contains_greek":
        return contains_range(format_scalar(values[0]), 0x0370, 0x03FF) if values else False
    if name == "bin":
        return format(int(to_number(values[0]) or 0), "b") if values else ""
    if name == "hex":
        return format(int(to_number(values[0]) or 0), "x") if values else ""
    if name == "oct":
        return format(int(to_number(values[0]) or 0), "o") if values else ""
    if name == "abs":
        num = to_number(values[0]) if values else None
        return abs(num) if num is not None else None
    if name == "power":
        if len(values) < 2:
            return None
        base = to_number(values[0])
        exp = to_number(values[1])
        return math.pow(base, exp) if base is not None and exp is not None else None
    if name == "sqrt":
        num = to_number(values[0]) if values else None
        return math.sqrt(num) if num is not None else None
    if name == "log":
        if len(values) < 2:
            return None
        value = to_number(values[0])
        base = to_number(values[1])
        return math.log(value, base) if value is not None and base is not None else None
    if name == "ln":
        value = to_number(values[0]) if values else None
        return math.log(value) if value is not None else None
    if name == "exp":
        value = to_number(values[0]) if values else None
        return math.exp(value) if value is not None else None
    if name == "least":
        present = [value for value in values if value is not None]
        return min(present) if present else None
    if name == "greatest":
        present = [value for value in values if value is not None]
        return max(present) if present else None
    if name == "pi":
        return math.pi
    if name == "floor":
        num = to_number(values[0]) if values else None
        return math.floor(num) if num is not None else None
    if name == "ceil":
        num = to_number(values[0]) if values else None
        return math.ceil(num) if num is not None else None
    if name == "round":
        if not values:
            return None
        number = to_number(values[0])
        if number is None:
            return None
        if len(values) > 1:
            digits = int(to_number(values[1]) or 0)
            return round(number, digits)
        return round(number)
    if name == "rand":
        if len(values) >= 2:
            start = int(to_number(values[0]) or 0)
            end = int(to_number(values[1]) or 0)
            return random.randint(start, end)
        if len(values) == 1:
            end = int(to_number(values[0]) or 0)
            return random.randint(0, end)
        return random.randint(0, 1)
    if name == "current_date":
        return dt.datetime.now().date()
    if name == "current_time":
        return dt.datetime.now().time().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat()
    if name == "current_timestamp":
        return dt.datetime.now().replace(microsecond=0)
    if name == "day":
        date_value = to_datetime(values[0], ctx.options) if values else None
        return date_value.day if date_value else None
    if name == "month":
        date_value = to_datetime(values[0], ctx.options) if values else None
        return date_value.month if date_value else None
    if name == "year":
        date_value = to_datetime(values[0], ctx.options) if values else None
        return date_value.year if date_value else None
    if name == "dayofweek":
        date_value = to_datetime(values[0], ctx.options) if values else None
        return ((date_value.weekday() + 1) % 7) + 1 if date_value else None
    if name == "dayname":
        date_value = to_datetime(values[0], ctx.options) if values else None
        return date_value.strftime("%A") if date_value else ""
    if name == "dayofyear":
        date_value = to_datetime(values[0], ctx.options) if values else None
        return int(date_value.strftime("%j")) if date_value else None
    if name == "date_add":
        if len(values) < 2:
            return None
        date_value = to_datetime(values[0], ctx.options)
        delta = to_number(values[1])
        return date_value + dt.timedelta(days=delta) if date_value is not None and delta is not None else None
    if name == "date_sub":
        if len(values) < 2:
            return None
        date_value = to_datetime(values[0], ctx.options)
        delta = to_number(values[1])
        return date_value - dt.timedelta(days=delta) if date_value is not None and delta is not None else None
    if name == "date_diff":
        if len(values) < 2:
            return None
        left = to_datetime(values[0], ctx.options)
        right = to_datetime(values[1], ctx.options)
        return (left - right).days if left and right else None
    if name == "from_unixtime":
        number = to_number(values[0]) if values else None
        return dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(number) if number is not None else None
    if name == "last_day":
        date_value = to_datetime(values[0], ctx.options) if values else None
        if date_value is None:
            return None
        next_month = date_value.replace(day=28) + dt.timedelta(days=4)
        last_day = next_month - dt.timedelta(days=next_month.day)
        return last_day.date()
    if name == "has_xattr":
        if row is None or not values:
            return False
        return row.has_xattr(format_scalar(values[0]))
    if name == "xattr":
        if row is None or not values:
            return ""
        return row.get_xattr(format_scalar(values[0]))
    if name == "has_extattr":
        if row is None or not values:
            return False
        return format_scalar(values[0]) in format_scalar(row.get("extattrs"))
    if name == "has_acl_entry":
        return False
    if name == "acl_entry":
        return ""
    if name == "has_default_acl_entry":
        return False
    if name == "default_acl_entry":
        return ""
    if name == "has_capability":
        if row is None:
            return False
        caps = format_scalar(row.get("capabilities"))
        if not values:
            return bool(caps)
        return format_scalar(values[0]) in caps
    if name == "format_size":
        return format_size(values[0]) if values else ""
    if name == "format_time":
        return format_duration(values[0]) if values else ""
    if name == "current_uid":
        return os.getuid()
    if name == "current_user":
        return pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_name
    if name == "current_gid":
        return os.getgid()
    if name == "current_group":
        return grp.getgrgid(os.getgid()).gr_name
    if name == "contains":
        if len(values) < 2:
            return False
        needle = format_scalar(values[0]).encode()
        path_value = format_scalar(values[1])
        if row is not None and path_value and not os.path.isabs(path_value):
            path_value = os.path.join(row.root.path, path_value)
        try:
            with open(path_value, "rb") as handle:
                return needle in handle.read()
        except Exception:
            return False
    if name == "coalesce":
        for value in values:
            if value not in (None, ""):
                return value
        return ""
    return ""


def eval_aggregate(name: str, args: list[Expr], rows: list["FileRow"], options: GlobalOptions) -> Any:
    if name == "count":
        if not args:
            return len(rows)
        if len(args) == 1 and isinstance(args[0], StarExpr):
            return len(rows)
        count = 0
        for row in rows:
            value = args[0].eval(EvalContext(options=options, row=row))
            if value not in (None, ""):
                count += 1
        return count
    if not rows:
        return None
    values = [args[0].eval(EvalContext(options=options, row=row)) for row in rows]
    present = [value for value in values if value not in (None, "")]
    if not present:
        return None
    if name == "min":
        return min(present)
    if name == "max":
        return max(present)
    numeric = [to_number(value) for value in present]
    numeric = [value for value in numeric if value is not None]
    if not numeric:
        return None
    if name == "sum":
        return sum(numeric)
    if name == "avg":
        return sum(numeric) / len(numeric)
    if name == "stddev_pop":
        mean = sum(numeric) / len(numeric)
        variance = sum((value - mean) ** 2 for value in numeric) / len(numeric)
        return math.sqrt(variance)
    if name == "stddev_samp":
        if len(numeric) < 2:
            return None
        mean = sum(numeric) / len(numeric)
        variance = sum((value - mean) ** 2 for value in numeric) / (len(numeric) - 1)
        return math.sqrt(variance)
    if name == "var_pop":
        mean = sum(numeric) / len(numeric)
        return sum((value - mean) ** 2 for value in numeric) / len(numeric)
    if name == "var_samp":
        if len(numeric) < 2:
            return None
        mean = sum(numeric) / len(numeric)
        return sum((value - mean) ** 2 for value in numeric) / (len(numeric) - 1)
    return None


def contains_range(text: str, low: int, high: int) -> bool:
    return any(low <= ord(ch) <= high for ch in text)


@dataclass
class ResultRecord:
    values: list[Any]
    ctx: EvalContext


class FileRow:
    def __init__(self, root: RootSpec, entry_path: str, rel_path: str):
        self.root = root
        self.entry_path = entry_path
        self.rel_path = rel_path.replace(os.sep, "/")
        self.lstat = os.lstat(entry_path)
        self.stat = os.stat(entry_path) if root.follow_symlinks else self.lstat
        self.cache: dict[str, Any] = {}

    @property
    def basename(self) -> str:
        return self.rel_path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]

    @property
    def extension(self) -> str:
        name = self.basename
        if "." not in name:
            return ""
        if name.startswith(".") and name.count(".") == 1:
            return ""
        return name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1]

    @property
    def filename(self) -> str:
        name = self.basename
        if "." not in name:
            return name
        if name.startswith(".") and name.count(".") == 1:
            return name
        return name.rsplit(".", 1)[0]

    @property
    def dirpath(self) -> str:
        parts = self.rel_path.rsplit("/", 1)
        return parts[0] if len(parts) > 1 else ""

    def open_binary(self) -> bytes:
        with open(self.entry_path, "rb") as handle:
            return handle.read()

    def has_xattr(self, name: str) -> bool:
        try:
            return name in os.listxattr(self.entry_path, follow_symlinks=self.root.follow_symlinks)
        except Exception:
            return False

    def get_xattr(self, name: str) -> str:
        try:
            value = os.getxattr(self.entry_path, name, follow_symlinks=self.root.follow_symlinks)
            return value.decode(errors="replace")
        except Exception:
            return ""

    def get(self, canonical: str) -> Any:
        if canonical in self.cache:
            return self.cache[canonical]
        method = getattr(self, f"_field_{canonical}", None)
        value = method() if method else ""
        self.cache[canonical] = value
        return value

    def _field_name(self) -> str:
        return self.basename

    def _field_filename(self) -> str:
        return self.filename

    def _field_extension(self) -> str:
        return self.extension

    def _field_path(self) -> str:
        return self.rel_path

    def _field_absolute_path(self) -> str:
        return os.path.abspath(self.entry_path)

    def _field_directory(self) -> str:
        return self.dirpath

    def _field_absolute_directory(self) -> str:
        return os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(self.entry_path))

    def _field_size(self) -> int:
        return int(self.stat.st_size)

    def _field_formatted_size(self) -> str:
        return format_size(self._field_size())

    def _field_uid(self) -> int:
        return self.stat.st_uid

    def _field_gid(self) -> int:
        return self.stat.st_gid

    def _field_user(self) -> str:
        try:
            return pwd.getpwuid(self.stat.st_uid).pw_name
        except KeyError:
            return str(self.stat.st_uid)

    def _field_group(self) -> str:
        try:
            return grp.getgrgid(self.stat.st_gid).gr_name
        except KeyError:
            return str(self.stat.st_gid)

    def _field_created(self) -> Any:
        ts = birthtime(self.entry_path, self.root.follow_symlinks)
        if ts is None:
            ts = self.stat.st_mtime
        return dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts).replace(microsecond=0)

    def _field_accessed(self) -> Any:
        return dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(self.stat.st_atime).replace(microsecond=0)

    def _field_modified(self) -> Any:
        return dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(self.stat.st_mtime).replace(microsecond=0)

    def _field_atime(self) -> int:
        return int(self.stat.st_atime)

    def _field_mtime(self) -> int:
        return int(self.stat.st_mtime)

    def _field_ctime(self) -> int:
        return int(self.stat.st_ctime)

    def _field_is_dir(self) -> bool:
        return stat.S_ISDIR(self.stat.st_mode)

    def _field_is_file(self) -> bool:
        return stat.S_ISREG(self.stat.st_mode)

    def _field_is_symlink(self) -> bool:

def birthtime(path: str, follow_symlinks: bool) -> Optional[float]:
    try:
        stat_result = os.stat(path, follow_symlinks=follow_symlinks)
        st_birthtime = getattr(stat_result, "st_birthtime", None)
        if st_birthtime is not None:
            return float(st_birthtime)
    except Exception:
        pass

    global _STATX_BTIME
    if _STATX_BTIME is None:
        try:
            import ctypes

            class StatxTimestamp(ctypes.Structure):
                _fields_ = [("tv_sec", ctypes.c_longlong), ("tv_nsec", ctypes.c_uint32), ("reserved", ctypes.c_int32)]

            class Statx(ctypes.Structure):
                _fields_ = [
                    ("stx_mask", ctypes.c_uint32),
                    ("stx_blksize", ctypes.c_uint32),
                    ("stx_attributes", ctypes.c_uint64),
                    ("stx_nlink", ctypes.c_uint32),
                    ("stx_uid", ctypes.c_uint32),
                    ("stx_gid", ctypes.c_uint32),
                    ("stx_mode", ctypes.c_uint16),
                    ("spare0", ctypes.c_uint16),
                    ("stx_ino", ctypes.c_uint64),
                    ("stx_size", ctypes.c_uint64),
                    ("stx_blocks", ctypes.c_uint64),
                    ("stx_attributes_mask", ctypes.c_uint64),
                    ("stx_atime", StatxTimestamp),
                    ("stx_btime", StatxTimestamp),
                    ("stx_ctime", StatxTimestamp),
                    ("stx_mtime", StatxTimestamp),
                    ("stx_rdev_major", ctypes.c_uint32),
                    ("stx_rdev_minor", ctypes.c_uint32),
                    ("stx_dev_major", ctypes.c_uint32),
                    ("stx_dev_minor", ctypes.c_uint32),
                    ("spare", ctypes.c_uint64 * 14),
                ]

            libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)

            def _statx_btime(target: str, follow: bool) -> Optional[float]:
                buf = Statx()
                flags = 0 if follow else 0x100
                if libc.statx(-100, target.encode(), flags, 0x0800, ctypes.byref(buf)) != 0:
                    return None
                if not (buf.stx_mask & 0x0800):
                    return None
                return float(buf.stx_btime.tv_sec)

            _STATX_BTIME = _statx_btime
        except Exception:
            _STATX_BTIME = False
    if _STATX_BTIME:
        try:
            return _STATX_BTIME(path, follow_symlinks)
        except Exception:
            return None
    return None


def traverse_root(root: RootSpec) -> Iterator[FileRow]:
    try:
        Path(root.path).resolve(strict=True)
    except OSError as exc:
        raise QueryIoError(f"{root.raw_path}: could not canonicalize path: {exc.strerror} (os error {exc.errno})") from exc

    visited: set[str] = set()
    if root.traversal == "dfs":
        yield from traverse_dfs(root, root.path, "", 0, visited)
        return
    queue: deque[tuple[str, str, int]] = deque([(root.path, "", 0)])
    while queue:
        current_path, current_rel, depth = queue.popleft()
        try:
            entries = list(os.scandir(current_path))
        except OSError as exc:
            raise QueryIoError(f"{root.raw_path if current_path == root.path else current_path}: {exc.strerror} (os error {exc.errno})") from exc
        for entry in entries:
            rel = entry.name if not current_rel else f"{current_rel}/{entry.name}"
            child_depth = depth + 1
            row = FileRow(root, entry.path, rel)
            if child_depth >= root.mindepth and (root.maxdepth is None or child_depth <= root.maxdepth):
                yield row
            if row.get("is_dir") and (root.maxdepth is None or child_depth < root.maxdepth):
                if root.follow_symlinks:
                    real = os.path.realpath(entry.path)
                    if real in visited:
                        continue
                    visited.add(real)
                queue.append((entry.path, rel, child_depth))


def traverse_dfs(root: RootSpec, current_path: str, current_rel: str, depth: int, visited: set[str]) -> Iterator[FileRow]:
    try:
        entries = list(os.scandir(current_path))
    except OSError as exc:
        raise QueryIoError(f"{root.raw_path if current_path == root.path else current_path}: {exc.strerror} (os error {exc.errno})") from exc
    for entry in entries:
        rel = entry.name if not current_rel else f"{current_rel}/{entry.name}"
        child_depth = depth + 1
        row = FileRow(root, entry.path, rel)
        if child_depth >= root.mindepth and (root.maxdepth is None or child_depth <= root.maxdepth):
            yield row
        if row.get("is_dir") and (root.maxdepth is None or child_depth < root.maxdepth):
            if root.follow_symlinks:
                real = os.path.realpath(entry.path)
                if real in visited:
                    continue
                visited.add(real)
            yield from traverse_dfs(root, entry.path, rel, child_depth, visited)


def execute_query(query: Query, options: GlobalOptions) -> list[ResultRecord]:
    rows: list[FileRow] = []
    for root in query.roots:
        rows.extend(traverse_root(root))

    if query.where is not None:
        filtered = []
        for row in rows:
            if truthy(query.where.eval(EvalContext(options=options, row=row))):
                filtered.append(row)
        rows = filtered

    grouped_records: list[ResultRecord] = []
    has_aggregate = any(expr.contains_aggregate() for expr in query.select)

    if query.group_by:
        groups: OrderedDict[tuple[Any, ...], list[FileRow]] = OrderedDict()
        for row in rows:
            key = tuple(expr.eval(EvalContext(options=options, row=row)) for expr in query.group_by)
            groups.setdefault(key, []).append(row)
        for group_rows in groups.values():
            ctx = EvalContext(options=options, group=group_rows)
            grouped_records.append(ResultRecord([expr.eval(ctx) for expr in query.select], ctx))
    elif has_aggregate:
        ctx = EvalContext(options=options, group=rows)
        grouped_records.append(ResultRecord([expr.eval(ctx) for expr in query.select], ctx))
    else:
        for row in rows:
            ctx = EvalContext(options=options, row=row)
            grouped_records.append(ResultRecord([expr.eval(ctx) for expr in query.select], ctx))

    if query.order_by:
        for item in reversed(query.order_by):
            grouped_records.sort(
                key=lambda record, item=item: order_value_for_record(item, record),
                reverse=item.direction == "desc",
            )

    if query.offset:
        grouped_records = grouped_records[query.offset:]
    if query.limit is not None:
        grouped_records = grouped_records[:query.limit]

    if query.group_by and not rows:
        return []
    return grouped_records


def order_value_for_record(item: OrderItem, record: ResultRecord) -> tuple[int, Any]:
    if item.position is not None:
        index = item.position - 1
        if index < 0 or index >= len(record.values):
            raise QueryError("query: Order by field index is out of range")
        return sort_key(record.values[index])
    return sort_key(item.expr.eval(record.ctx))


def render_output(query: Query, records: list[ResultRecord]) -> bytes:
    rows = [[format_scalar(value) for value in record.values] for record in records]
    if query.output_format == "tabs":
        return render_text_rows(rows, "\t")
    if query.output_format == "lines":
        return render_lines(rows)
    if query.output_format == "list":
        return render_list(rows)
    if query.output_format == "csv":
        return render_csv(rows)
    if query.output_format == "json":
        return render_json(query, rows)
    if query.output_format == "html":
        return render_html(query, rows)
    return render_text_rows(rows, "\t")


def render_text_rows(rows: list[list[str]], sep: str) -> bytes:
    if not rows:
        return b""
    return ("\n".join(sep.join(row) for row in rows) + "\n").encode()


def render_lines(rows: list[list[str]]) -> bytes:
    if not rows:
        return b""
    return ("\n".join(value for row in rows for value in row) + "\n").encode()


def render_list(rows: list[list[str]]) -> bytes:
    values = [value for row in rows for value in row]
    if not values:
        return b""
    return ("\0".join(values) + "\0").encode()


def render_csv(rows: list[list[str]]) -> bytes:
    if not rows:
        return b""
    buffer = io.StringIO()
    writer = csv.writer(buffer, lineterminator="\n")
    for row in rows:
        writer.writerow(row)
    return buffer.getvalue().encode()


def render_json(query: Query, rows: list[list[str]]) -> bytes:
    payload = []
    labels = [expr.label() for expr in query.select]
    for row in rows:
        items = sorted(zip(labels, row), key=lambda item: item[0])
        payload.append({key: value for key, value in items})
    return (json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode()


def render_html(query: Query, rows: list[list[str]]) -> bytes:
    if not rows:
        return b""
    title = html.escape(query.raw)
    cells = []
    for row in rows:
        cells.append("<tr>" + "".join(f"<td>{html.escape(value)}</td>" for value in row) + "</tr>")
    document = f"<html><head><title>{title}</title></head><body><table><tr><th colspan=\"{len(query.select)}\">{title}</th></tr>{''.join(cells)}</table></body></html>\n"
    return document.encode()


def run_query(raw_query: str, options: GlobalOptions, cwd: str) -> bytes:
    query = parse_query(raw_query, cwd)
    records = execute_query(query, options)
    return render_output(query, records)


def parse_cli(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[GlobalOptions, str, Optional[str]]:
    options = GlobalOptions()
    mode = "run"
    query_tokens: list[str] = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        arg = argv[i]
        lower = arg.lower()
        if query_tokens:
            query_tokens.append(arg)
            i += 1
            continue
        if lower in {"--help", "-h", "/?", "/h"}:
            mode = "help"
            i += 1
            continue
        if lower == "--version":
            mode = "version"
            i += 1
            continue
        if lower in {"--interactive", "-i", "/i"}:
            options.interactive = True
            i += 1
            continue
        if lower in {"--config", "-c", "/config"} and i + 1 < len(argv):
            options.config_path = argv[i + 1]
            i += 2
            continue
        if lower in {"--nocolor", "--no-color", "/nocolor"}:
            options.nocolor = True
            i += 1
            continue
        if lower == "--no-errors":
            options.no_errors = True
            i += 1
            continue
        if lower == "--us-dates":
            options.us_dates = True
            i += 1
            continue
        query_tokens.extend(argv[i:])
        break
    return options, mode, " ".join(query_tokens) if query_tokens else None


def run_interactive(options: GlobalOptions) -> int:
    errors_enabled = not options.no_errors
    while True:
        try:
            line = input("query> ")
        except EOFError:
            return 0
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            sys.stdout.write("\n")
            return 0
        command = line.strip()
        if not command:
            continue
        lower = command.lower()
        if lower in {"exit", "quit"}:
            return 0
        if lower == "help":
            sys.stdout.write(HELP_TEXT + "\n")
            continue
        if lower == "pwd":
            sys.stdout.write(os.getcwd() + "\n")
            continue
        if lower.startswith("cd "):
            target = command[3:].strip()
            try:
                os.chdir(target)
            except OSError as exc:
                if errors_enabled:
                    sys.stderr.write(f"{target}: {exc.strerror} (os error {exc.errno})\n")
            continue
        if lower.startswith("errors"):
            parts = command.split()
            if len(parts) == 1:
                errors_enabled = not errors_enabled
            elif parts[1].lower() == "on":
                errors_enabled = True
            elif parts[1].lower() == "off":
                errors_enabled = False
            sys.stdout.write(f"Errors are {'ON' if errors_enabled else 'OFF'}\n")
            continue
        try:
            output = run_query(command, GlobalOptions(**{**options.__dict__, "no_errors": not errors_enabled}), os.getcwd())
            sys.stdout.buffer.write(output)
            sys.stdout.flush()
        except FselectError as exc:
            if errors_enabled:
                sys.stderr.write(str(exc) + "\n")
        except Exception as exc:
            if errors_enabled:
                sys.stderr.write(str(exc) + "\n")


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    options, mode, query = parse_cli(argv)
    if mode == "help":
        sys.stdout.write(HELP_TEXT + "\n")
        return 0
    if mode == "version":
        sys.stdout.write(SHORT_INFO + "\n")
        return 0
    if options.interactive and not query:
        return run_interactive(options)
    if not query:
        sys.stdout.write(NOARG_INFO + "\n")
        return 0
    try:
        output = run_query(query, options, os.getcwd())
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(output)
        sys.stdout.flush()
        return 0
    except FselectError as exc:
        if not options.no_errors:
            sys.stderr.write(str(exc) + "\n")
        return exc.exit_code
    except OSError as exc:
        if not options.no_errors:
            sys.stderr.write(f"{exc.filename or ''}: {exc.strerror} (os error {exc.errno})\n")
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
